name: Mississippi
feeText: The chancery clerk's filing fee depends on the county; the Administrative Office of Courts guide says to call the Chancery Clerk for the amount and that it should be less than $100.00. The Hinds County figure was not found on an official page.

waiver.name: Motion to Proceed In Forma Pauperis (AOC sample form)

waitingPeriod.text: In an irreconcilable differences divorce the parties must wait 60 days before the divorce can be set for hearing, and the 60 days do not start on the day of filing; either spouse may withdraw consent during the waiting period (Mississippi Administrative Office of Courts guide 'How to File an Irreconcilable Differences Divorce Case in Mississippi').

simplified.text: Irreconcilable differences divorce on a joint complaint signed by both spouses before a notary, with a property settlement agreement (Mississippi AOC guide).

uncertain: Mississippi publishes its code only through LexisNexis, which could not be read; the residency requirement (Miss. Code Ann. § 93-5-5) and the statutory basis of the 60-day wait (§ 93-5-2) were not read on an official page. Residency is left null.
Hinds County chancery clerk divorce filing fee: not found (hindscountyms.com lists no chancery fee schedule in the archived pages checked); filingFee is null.

The AOC guide was read from the Internet Archive 2026 copy of the official courts.ms.gov PDF. The 'Motion to Proceed In Forma Pauperis' URL is from the archive index; the PDF itself could not be downloaded, so its exact title was not read.
Parenting class: not researched or verified.
